[[File:Smoke Blitz icon (mobile).png|left]]
'''Smoke Blitz''' is the second highest level [[smoke spell]] in the [[Ancient Magicks]] spell book, and it requires a [[Magic]] level of 74. It is capable of hitting up to 23 damage (without any [[magic damage]] boosts) per cast.

Smoke Blitz is capable of [[poison]]ing a target at a 1/8 chance on hit, having a [[poison severity]] of 20 (where poison starts at 4 damage every 30 [[Tick|ticks]] or 18 seconds); this can be increased to 22 with an [[ancient sceptre]]. Increasing the total poison damage to 60 (first two hits does 5 damage), instead of 50.

As with all [[Ancient Magicks]] spells, the quest [[Desert Treasure I]] must be completed to cast this spell.
